maria_support: Customer reports monthly tokens showed as refilled in the Console at local midnight but API calls immediately returned 429 for ~2 hours. They upgraded plan 3 days ago (prorate). Customer provided a minimal repro and said rotating the API key made requests succeed. Can someone look?

ken_billing: Which account ID and billing event timestamp? did promo/topup apply or was it just plan proration?

maria_support: acct_7890. Billing event from Stripe: 2026-02-28T23:59:50Z (prorate topup). Customer timeline: UI shows 1000 tokens at 00:00 PST, API returns 429 until ~02:12 PST. They rotated key at 02:13 and subsequent calls succeeded. They included this curl + response: 
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-live-REDACTED" \n  -d '{"input":"hello"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"quota_exceeded","message":"monthly credits exhausted","request_id":"req_01G7XYZ","retry_after":3600}
```

jess_eng: Thanks. That looks like a propagation/cache issue between billing/topup write and the quota cache. Any long-lived connections or streaming sessions from that tenant? Those can hold stale usage state. Also want the exact request_id (they gave req_01G7XYZ) and the header X-Quota-Version if present.

maria_support: Customer says they had a long-running websocket that had reconnects during rollover. They also confirmed rotating the key fixed it (immediate success). No X-Quota-Version header in their example.

jess_eng: I'm going to flush the tenant quota cache and monitor. Workaround noted (rotate key). Suspect the Stripe webhook handler writes the topup but we don't emit tenant-cache-invalidated for prorate/topup events in some code paths. Filing INF-8423 to add an explicit cache invalidation publish for billing events.

deploy_bot: Cache flush initiated for tenant acct_7890 by jess_eng at 2026-03-15T02:34:10Z
deploy_bot: Cache flush completed for tenant acct_7890 at 2026-03-15T02:34:15Z

jess_eng: Root cause: billing service persisted the balance but the event bridge path that triggers quota-service invalidation was skipped for the prorate webhook path. Patch queued to emit invalidation and add an end-to-end test. Workaround: rotate API key or wait for background sync (~up to 2 hours).

maria_support: Informed customer of workaround and ticket. They rotated key and confirmed calls succeed. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
